verdict.rationale: Unreal exposes very broad programmatic surfaces — C++ gameplay/engine code, Python editor scripting (including building custom editor UIs and automating asset pipelines), a Remote Control HTTP/WebSocket API that can call any Blueprint-callable function, plus CLI/UAT automation for build/cook/package/deploy — which together cover a large fraction of what the Editor UI does. However, there is no documentation explicitly claiming full 1:1 API/UI parity, community feedback notes real limits (e.g. Blueprint-only workflows requiring C++ for certain features, some editor tasks tightly coupled to UI), and Remote Control is scoped to BlueprintCallable functions rather than every editor operation; probe evidence also shows poor machine-readability/agent accessibility (gated source repo, WAF-blocked docs, no official MCP), undermining reliable programmatic parity for an AI-native consumer. missing for 10: an explicit claim/verification of complete UI-to-API parity, and reliable machine-readable/agent-friendly access to that API surface.
